response.sql: WITH status_averages AS (SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rfistat), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL), qualifying AS (SELECT s.rfistat, s.avg_modindex, o.avg_modindex AS overall_avg FROM status_averages AS s CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o WHERE s.avg_modindex > o.avg_modindex) SELECT rfistat AS status, avg_modindex, avg_modindex - overall_avg AS above_average_by, avg_modindex - AVG(avg_modindex) OVER () AS difference_from_qualifying_mean FROM qualifying;

assumptions.assumption: “Above average” compares each status average with the average across all signals that have a modulation index.

alternatives.interpretation: Compare each status average with the unweighted mean of all status averages.
alternatives.sql: WITH status_averages AS (SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rfistat), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) AS avg_modindex FROM status_averages), qualifying AS (SELECT s.rfistat, s.avg_modindex, b.avg_modindex AS baseline_avg FROM status_averages AS s CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE s.avg_modindex > b.avg_modindex) SELECT rfistat AS status, avg_modindex, avg_modindex - baseline_avg AS above_average_by, avg_modindex - AVG(avg_modindex) OVER () AS difference_from_qualifying_mean FROM qualifying;
